title: Villa Menthe | KEY.co
description_expanded: The upper stories of Villa Menthe continue to impress, offering versatile sleeping arrangements and leisure spaces. The second floor features a charming bunk nook for kids, additional guest bedrooms with queen beds, a luxurious master suite with a king bed, an en suite bathroom that includes both a shower and a soaking tub, and access to a balcony that presents leisure options such as a ping pong table, a bed swing, and a fireplace—all set against the tranquil backdrop of the Nature Preserve. The third floor provides a perfect hangout for teens, creating a playful escape. Outdoors, the amenities further enhance the allure with a heatable pool, a cozy sitting spa, and a covered lounge area with a fireplace. A ready-to-use grill caps off the setting, ideal for enjoying those delightful summer meals. Villa Menthe is not just a place to stay—it's a luxurious retreat designed to create unforgettable experiences in the heart of Watercolor.
